contract.core_definition: Core is literal real matrix on left bond and bit/right pair; fixed-bit slice is literal restriction.
contract.contraction_definition: Ordered product of slices; retains all initial rows and terminal columns.
contract.right_canonical_definition: Every core Q has Q Q^T = I, summing the complete bit/right pair; empty chain true. Real transpose, not complex adjoint.
contract.flatten_definition: Literal e(b,j)=b*r+j via finite-product equivalence, right bond fastest; inverse is only evaluated on actual finite indices, including vacuous zero-width case.
contract.supplier: Specified deterministic factors of flattened B with s=min(l,2*r), residual l x s, core s x (2*r), exact B=R Q and Q Q^T=I. No numerical-rank or unique-representative claim; these are produced facts, not caller premises.
contract.supplier_branches: For m<=q, adjacent bottom-up row elimination of H^T in increasing column order with negative exact splitAngle, zero pair angle zero, produces Z=T H^T, square orthogonal T, lower zeros. Restrict Z^T and T to first m coordinates. For m>q return H and I_q. Equality uses first branch. No rank/sign premise.
contract.producer: Tail-first recursion: empty -> identity residual/same empty chain; cons -> recursively obtain S,E, absorb B(a,b,j)=sum_u A(a,b,u)S(u,j), factor this B, return R,Q::E. Same length and terminal dimension.
contract.dimension_definition: RankReduced compares actual original/returned chains: s_n=d_n and s_i=min(d_i,2*s_(i+1)); no singular-value truncation or minimal bond claim. maxBond includes boundaries.
contract.boundary_definition: Literal row-vector multiplication w=vR for arbitrary real v, with no nonzero premise.
contract.mass_definitions: mass(z)=sum_j z_j^2; chainMass(C,v)=sum_word sum_terminal (v M_C(word))_j^2, retaining every terminal label.
contract.scalar_definition: For initial and terminal dimensions 1, stateBoundary is boundary(C,(1)), with unique indices 0.
contract.conclusions: Every word matrix M_C=R M_D exactly, D right-canonical and dimension-reduced, maxBond(D)<=maxBond(C); boundary action vM_C=wM_D; chainMass(C,v)=mass(w). Only normalized input mass implies normalized boundary. Scalar action unconditional; scalar normalization conditional on sum_word M_C(word)_(0,0)^2=1.
